name: Tarot Relics: High Priestess Rising
overview:
For years, an orphan has been haunted by voices whispering from every antique she touches.

Everything changes when she meets the only man who can silence them—a mysterious librarian hiding a power of his own. Together, they uncover a forgotten destiny tied to the legendary Tarot.

Now the cards are awakening... and so is the girl chosen to wield them.
